_meta.name: semantic claims map — P5 orchestration-economics
_meta.purpose: Map every risky claim in the paper (comparisons, causes, recommendations, costs, percentages) to the exact raw-data source that proves it. Unlike the numeric claim map (exact strings), this map captures MEANING — the claims a numeric string-match cannot catch.

schema.section: section/subsection as the reader sees it in the PDF
schema.paper_line: line in paper/P5_v15.6.tex where the quote starts
schema.full_quote: the complete claim sentence, verbatim from the draft
schema.what_it_means: one plain-language line: what the claim says and what could make it wrong

source.location: line range / JSON key path / table row+col
source.exact_values: verbatim value(s) — both sides for comparisons

schema.code: script that computed derived numbers; null when read directly

_meta.ordering: paper order: title/abstract → intro → methods → results → discussion → managerial → limitations → future → conclusion → exec summary
_meta.audit_summary: 48 claims swept; 46 verified against raw sources; 2 flagged — SC-4.2-006 DISCREPANCY ('8% gap recovery' is a stale pilot number; pooled locked data give -3%, matching §4.2.1) and SC-1-001 wording slip (intro says personas 'raise cost'; ledger shows persona cells emit fewer tokens and price slightly below twins — value destruction is via quality, not cost)
_meta.captions_note: 28 captions swept 2026-09-24: every figure/table caption mapped to its frozen source and cross-referenced to the SC claim that carries the same numbers. Two captions rewritten this week to match redrawn figures (fig3 CI-of-mean bars; fig5 dumbbell chart).
